from_speaker: every single AI service you use
every single service is losing money as a result
our_interpretation: The context concerns paid generative-AI services. The ordinary reading is that their subscription receipts fail to cover serving-compute costs, causing service-level losses.
A company-wide loss caused by research, training, marketing, or other expenses does not establish this claim.
I use January–March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, for the ongoing financial state. The speaker supplied no reporting period.
No common accounting basis or definition of loss is supplied. The contract therefore records an unknown accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable service-level revenue and actual serving-compute expenses show that every relevant service subsidized compute and consequently incurred losses during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A relevant service demonstrably covered its serving-compute costs from customer receipts, or earned a service-level profit, during the target period.
